cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: User approved single-machine manual capability contracts and backend optimization on the release baseline.
impact: One formal version line; no frontend implementation or release authorization.
lesson: Keep a release tag baseline separate from later governance evidence; validate shared imports before tests.

cause: Checkout-specific PID locks admitted simultaneous gate bodies in separate worktrees and TMPDIR values.
impact: Fixed host-wide flock supervisor; lightweight targeted suites pass. Old checkouts still need manual exclusion. Full gate deferred to final integration.
lesson: Use one stable lock inode and retain ownership through child shutdown; metadata PIDs are not authority.

cause: The context provider had 5445 lines across registration, data, model, workflow and projection responsibilities.
impact: Facade and all extracted modules under 2000 lines; 145 affected tests passed; 120 definitions unchanged apart from import relocation.
lesson: Keep bounded projection semantics and source-reading guards when splitting tool modules; relocation is not a family-literal reduction.

cause: Generic graph node identifiers were included in the family literal ratchet.
impact: Tag and current checkout reproduce 119 minus 45 generic node identifiers equals 74. No implementation reduction claimed.
lesson: Correct measurement separately before reducing shared family dispatch; retain unknown family identifiers and the same scanned paths.

cause: Manual operations and reports must run through shared deterministic services without a model provider.
impact: Six additive HTTP operations, generated types and provider-free manual graph proposals; focused execution, lifecycle, report and type checks passed. Full gate and UI acceptance remain open.
lesson: Use declaration-specific confirmation and exact owned artifact identities; high risk is not a blanket execution ban and does not grant custom capability authority.

cause: Shared consumers duplicated family dispatch while legacy fits remained in central modules.
impact: Frozen measurement reduced from74 to54; five numerical families moved without body changes;103 related tests and21 native export checks passed.
lesson: Separate numerical ownership relocation from actual policy deduplication and preserve compatibility imports.

cause: The original-upload shortcut compared the selected frame with itself instead of proving raw-upload identity.
impact: A69-row selected dataset produced an80-row fitted model and omitted child dataset source lineage. Manual genesis acceptance remains open.
lesson: Assert actual fitted sample size and immutable source bytes across data-operation to model execution, not only successful status.

cause: Resolve exact registered selected dataset bytes and revalidate trusted source binding before durable model submission.
impact: New real CLI and HTTP executions both fit the selected 69 rows with matching coefficients and source lineage; old immutable results are retained.
lesson: Assert actual fitted sample size and immutable source bytes across data-operation to model execution, not only successful status.

cause: Native R/Stata comparison exposes omitted interaction contribution in time margins; current LR provenance cannot establish admissible comparisons.
impact: LMM LR and margins remain closed. NB1 native R re-estimation is not run because glmmTMB is absent.
lesson: Recompute owner results against frozen native references and preserve actual failures; admission is separate from evidence-test success.
